hints: Differentiate each position to get each velocity, then set them equal.
worded:
1. Velocity is the slope of each position formula: v_P = a + 2bt and v_Q = f − 2t.

2. P starts at a and speeds up; Q starts at f and slows down. If f > a they cross once.

3. Equal when a + 2bt = f − 2t, i.e. t = (f − a)/2(1 + b). (B)
conventional:
![](asset:P000146-sol-1)

$$v_{P} = a + 2bt,\quad\quad v_{Q} = f - 2t.$$

$$a + 2bt = f - 2t\  \Rightarrow \ t = \frac{f - a}{2(1 + b)}.$$
mistakes: Equal velocities is not the same as equal positions (meeting); don’t set x_P = x_Q.
